name: Capriles Radonski
scope: Dedicated Capriles audit. Only this report and tests/character-audits/capriles.test.ts were written in the repository. No shared/runtime edits, asset changes, commits, child agents or new web research.

identityAndPortrayal.requiredAppearance: Keep the requested tricolor cap with stars, gray rolled-sleeve shirt, jeans and white sneakers; no glasses. No appearance edits were made.
identityAndPortrayal.visualAssessment: Native runtime views retain the reference's long oval face, rounded nose tip, visible ears and smiling mouth. Cap and gray shirt remain consistent across eight poses, greeting and mirrored P2. This is a visual comparison, not a biometric measurement.
identityAndPortrayal.sourceLimit: The supplied dossier identifies the main cap-and-shirt photograph as 2012 archive material and distinguishes this requested attire from recent clips. This audit preserves that distinction and asserts no freshly verified current office or clothing facts.
identityAndPortrayal.fictionalAdaptation: Sprint tricolor and combat poses are fictional adaptations of the established speed/campaign portrayal, not claims about real fighting habits.

tests.method: Actual createMatch/stepMatch simulation completes the 510-tick intro before combat. Both sides use real input counters and movement. Focused probes arrange initial positions and energy. One full normal-CPU bout runs continuously, then repeats with deeply equal final states. Range/recovery probes log defects without asserting that those defects must remain.
coverage: Intro movement/attack lock and inward facing on both sides
Right/left movement, facing, neutral deceleration, two jumps, rejected third jump and landing on both sides
Light/heavy startup, damage, outward knockback and one-hit behavior on both sides
Special versus idle, correctly facing guard and turned-away guard on both sides
Special energy gate, dash speed, invincibility and no projectile
Range probes at 120, 214, 215, 220, 240, 300 and 420 pixels on both sides
Empty-lane recovery samples on both sides
Advanced combo win gate and definitive win/energy gates on both sides
Both named combos connect every actual strike using approach inputs on both sides
Full normal-CPU bout and deterministic repeat
P2 Capriles CPU selects and lands his sprint in a controlled opportunity

normalAttacksAgainstJavier.knockbackDirection: Outward from attacker on both sides

special.name: Sprint tricolor
special.actualBehavior: One forward strike occurs at startup, followed by movement with brief invincibility. Initial gap214 hits once; gap215 and larger sampled gaps miss. Later contact causes no damage. Full-speed movement continues after dash=0 until the attack ends. These behaviors are reported below.

combos.gateResults: Zero/two wins reject definitive; three wins allow it; energy74 rejects it on both sides.
combos.recognitionLimit: Combo labels recognize input history, so out-of-range setup lights can award the heavy bonus. Separate connected-combo tests prove all actual strikes can land with approach inputs.

completedCpuBout.interpretation: Aggressive scripted Capriles loses this bout. It verifies completion, both actors connecting, finite physics and deterministic state, not balance or a winning strategy.
completedCpuBout.separateP2CpuSpecial: At tick600, gap120, hard CPU chooses Sprint tricolor and hits once after nine steps, reducing Javier to hp85.4976.

selectionTrace.method: Clicked actual Capriles fighter button; sampled actual Portrait canvas dataset every 200 ms for 3.2 seconds.
selectionTrace.interpretation: Greeting articulates frame0 rather than changing atlas frames; it completes once and holds ready.

runtimeAtlas.olderQaLimit: docs/sprite-qa.json and assets/references/capriles/sprite-validation.json contain older atlas measurements. Current v22 bounds were confirmed through docs/character-sprite-qa.json and actual runtime loadSprite.

nativeVisualChecks.eightRuntimePosesViewed: Ready0, guard1, run2/3, tucked jump4, punch5, high kick6 and hurt7 were drawn through actual loadSprite/drawSprite and inspected. No clipped feet, borrowed limbs, absent cap, gray-shirt replacement or wrong facing appeared. Run A/B retain very similar leading-leg poses, an existing atlas limitation.
nativeVisualChecks.snapshotMethod: Imported actual renderer, asset loader, presentation renderer and shared engine into this audit's tab. Drew eight-frame/selection sheets, actual renderMatch intro states and engine-stepped special states. Saved screenshots outside the repository. Match montage rescales source canvases to fit eight stills and is used for content/pose inspection, not precise visual dimensions.
limitations: Visual judgments cover inspected stills and selection progress trace. Continuous animation and a complete browser fight were not watched.
Greeting is subtle raised-fist/head motion. It does not touch the brim; the existing name only promises Saludo casual.

Shared dev server restarted and hot reload briefly left the tab blank. Reloading restored the lobby. A later optional enlarged render failed because hot reload had removed its temporary main element; the three completed screenshots remain valid.
Audio was not audited by ear.
First report write failed when disk space reached zero. The empty report was rewritten after space became available.

findings.observation: Sprint tricolor checks damage only at startup9, before dash movement. An opponent reached during the dash remains unharmed, weakening the roster promise that this sprint punishes a stationary opponent across the arena.
findings.reproduction: After intro on Caracas: P1 Capriles x420, idle Javier x660, both on floor, energy100. Press special once. AttackTick9: Capriles x436, target hp100. AttackTick20: Capriles x612, target48px away, dash1, target hp100. Through step40: zero hits, target hp100, target displaced157.5px by body separation. Mirrored P2 reproduces the miss. Gap214 hits; gap215 and larger sampled gaps never hit.
findings.recommendedFix: Give sprint a bounded collision window during its active dash, allowing one hit or guard interaction per use. Preserve direction, energy cost, damage and invincibility. Add regression assertions for idle and correctly blocking targets first reached after startup.

findings.observation: The 12-tick dash expires while velocity stays at16px/tick for the remaining recovery. Movement inputs cannot decelerate while attack is set. Full-speed movement lasts32 ticks and travels512px before attack expiry, beyond configured192px dash travel.
findings.reproduction: After intro: Capriles x190, Javier x890, no movement inputs, energy100. Press special. Step20: x382, displacement192, dash1. Step21: x398, dash0, vx16. Step39: x686, dash0, vx16. Step40: x702, attack null, vx16, displacement512. Step41 finally decelerates to vx10.4. Mirror positions for P2 to get vx-16 and identical distances.
findings.recommendedFix: Brake or clear sprint horizontal velocity when its authored dash window ends, then let recovery finish without continued full-speed travel. Preserve the speed during the 12 active dash ticks.

findings.observation: Sprint uses guard1 through attackTick3 and straight-punch5 thereafter, including the dash. Native attackTick9/20 samples on both sides show the planted punch pose sliding toward the opponent. Generic blue effects and dash ghosts appear; no dedicated tricolor sprint trail or run-pose progression appears.
findings.reproduction: Activate Sprint tricolor and inspect attackTick9/20 on either side, or inspect the saved actual match montage.
findings.recommendedFix: Use existing run frames during the active sprint and a brief strike pose at contact. A restrained tricolor trail can improve recognition. Preserve capriles-v22 likeness, cap, gray shirt and passing combat values.
